obligations.action_summary: Consider, when deciding whether an environmental impact statement is needed, whether the action may cause or increase a disproportionate pollution burden on a disadvantaged community.
obligations.quote: the responsible agency shall consider whether such action may cause or increase a disproportionate pollution burden on a disadvantaged community that is directly or significantly indirectly affected by such action.
obligations.law_title: Relates to disproportionate impacts of environmental facility siting on disadvantaged communities

obligations.action_summary: Require applicants for a new project under an applicable permit to prepare an existing burden report when the project may contribute to a disproportionate pollution burden.
obligations.quote: When a new project subject to an applicable permit may cause or contribute more than a de minimis amount of pollution to any disproportionate pollution burden on a disadvantaged community, the department shall require the applicant to prepare or cause to be prepared an existing burden report
obligations.law_title: Relates to disproportionate impacts of environmental facility siting on disadvantaged communities

obligations.action_summary: Require an existing burden report for renewals or modifications of applicable permits that may contribute to a disproportionate pollution burden.
obligations.quote: the department shall require the applicant to prepare or cause to be prepared an existing burden report; provided, however that the department may elect not to require such existing burden report if the permit would serve an essential environmental, health, or safety need of the disadvantaged community for which there is no reasonable alternative.
obligations.law_title: Relates to disproportionate impacts of environmental facility siting on disadvantaged communities

obligations.action_summary: Consider the existing burden report and an administrative record including public comments when reviewing an application for an applicable permit.
obligations.quote: When considering an application for an applicable permit, the department shall consider the existing burden report, if any, and an administrative record that includes, but is not limited to, comments received from the public in the disadvantaged community.
obligations.law_title: Relates to disproportionate impacts of environmental facility siting on disadvantaged communities

obligations.action_summary: Refuse to issue an applicable permit for a new project that will contribute more than a de minimis amount of pollution to a disproportionate pollution burden.
obligations.quote: The department shall not issue an applicable permit for a new project if it determines that the project will cause or contribute more than a de minimis amount of pollution to a disproportionate pollution burden on the disadvantaged community.
obligations.law_title: Relates to disproportionate impacts of environmental facility siting on disadvantaged communities

obligations.action_summary: Refuse to issue a modified applicable permit that would significantly increase the existing disproportionate pollution burden.
obligations.quote: In the case of an application for a modification of an applicable permit, the department shall not issue an applicable permit if it determines that the issuance of the permit would significantly increase the existing disproportionate pollution burden on the disadvantaged community.
obligations.law_title: Relates to disproportionate impacts of environmental facility siting on disadvantaged communities

obligations.action_summary: Refuse to renew an applicable permit when the project would significantly increase the existing disproportionate pollution burden.
obligations.quote: In the case of an application for renewal of an applicable permit, the department shall not issue an applicable permit if it determines that the project would significantly increase the existing disproportionate pollution burden on the disadvantaged community.
obligations.law_title: Relates to disproportionate impacts of environmental facility siting on disadvantaged communities

obligations.action_summary: Require, as a condition of an applicable permit, reasonable and practicable operational changes that would reduce the pollution burden on the disadvantaged community.
obligations.quote: The department shall require actions to implement any appropriate operational changes which would reduce the pollution burden on the disadvantaged community as a condition of an applicable permit, only if such actions are reasonable and practicable, as determined by the department.
obligations.law_title: Relates to disproportionate impacts of environmental facility siting on disadvantaged communities

obligations.action_summary: Develop the scope of the existing burden report, in consultation with the department of health.
obligations.quote: The department, in consultation with the department of health, shall develop the scope of the existing burden report and may adapt such requirements based on whether a permit application is for a new project, modification, or a renewal of a permit.
obligations.law_title: Relates to disproportionate impacts of environmental facility siting on disadvantaged communities

obligations.action_summary: Provide at least a thirty-day public comment period before finalizing the scope of the existing burden report.
obligations.quote: The department shall provide for at least a thirty-day public comment period prior to finalizing the scope of the report.
obligations.law_title: Relates to disproportionate impacts of environmental facility siting on disadvantaged communities

obligations.action_summary: Promulgate rules and regulations to effectuate the act and the 2022 environmental facility siting act.
obligations.quote: The commissioner of environmental conservation is authorized and directed to promulgate rules and regulations in accordance with subdivision one of section 70-0107 of the environmental conservation law to effectuate the provisions of this act
obligations.law_title: Relates to disproportionate impacts of environmental facility siting on disadvantaged communities

obligations.law_title: Relates to a demonstration program implementing speed violation monitoring systems in school zones by means of photo devices

obligations.action_summary: Install warning signs notifying drivers that a photo speed violation monitoring system is in use in a school speed zone.
obligations.quote: The city shall install signs giving notice that a photo speed violation monitoring system is in use to be mounted on advance warning signs notifying motor vehicle operators of such upcoming school speed zone and/or on speed limit signs applicable within such school speed zone, in conformance with standards established in the MUTCD.
obligations.law_title: Relates to a demonstration program implementing speed violation monitoring systems in school zones by means of photo devices

obligations.actor_raw: operators of photo speed violation monitoring systems

obligations.law_title: Relates to a demonstration program implementing speed violation monitoring systems in school zones by means of photo devices

obligations.action_summary: Have each camera operator complete and sign a daily set-up log recording setup details and self-test results.
obligations.quote: Each such operator shall complete and sign a daily set-up log for each such system that he or she operates that (i) states the date and time when, and the location where, the system was set up that day, and (ii) states that such operator successfully performed, and the system passed, the self-tests of such system before producing a recorded image that day.
obligations.law_title: Relates to a demonstration program implementing speed violation monitoring systems in school zones by means of photo devices

obligations.action_summary: Retain each daily set-up log until the camera is permanently removed from use or related cases are finally resolved.
obligations.quote: The city shall retain each such daily log until the later of the date on which the photo speed violation monitoring system to which it applies has been permanently removed from use or the final resolution of all cases involving notices of liability issued based on photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images produced by such system.
obligations.law_title: Relates to a demonstration program implementing speed violation monitoring systems in school zones by means of photo devices

obligations.action_summary: Have each photo speed violation monitoring system undergo an annual calibration check and keep the resulting certificate on file.
obligations.quote: Each photo speed violation monitoring system shall undergo an annual calibration check performed by an independent calibration laboratory which shall issue a signed certificate of calibration. The city shall keep each such annual certificate of calibration on file until the final resolution of all cases involving a notice of liability issued during such year which were based on photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images produced by such photo speed violation monitoring system.
obligations.law_title: Relates to a demonstration program implementing speed violation monitoring systems in school zones by means of photo devices

obligations.action_summary: Use technologies to ensure, to the extent practicable, that recorded images do not identify the driver, passengers, or vehicle contents.
obligations.quote: Such demonstration program shall utilize necessary technologies to ensure, to the extent practicable, that photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images produced by such photo speed violation monitoring systems shall not include images that identify the driver, the passengers, or the contents of the vehicle.
obligations.law_title: Relates to a demonstration program implementing speed violation monitoring systems in school zones by means of photo devices

obligations.action_summary: Destroy recorded images upon final resolution of the related notice of liability or one year after issuance, whichever is later.

obligations.law_title: Relates to a demonstration program implementing speed violation monitoring systems in school zones by means of photo devices

obligations.actor_raw: the parking violations bureau of the city of Syracuse

obligations.action_summary: Send a notice of liability by first class mail within 14 business days for resident owners and 45 business days for non-resident owners.

obligations.action_summary: Include required identifying and evidentiary information in each notice of liability.

obligations.law_title: Relates to a demonstration program implementing speed violation monitoring systems in school zones by means of photo devices

obligations.action_summary: Prepare and mail notices of liability, or authorize another entity to do so.
